name: EPIC-KITCHENS-100
tagline: 100 h / 20M frames of unscripted kitchen video from 37 participants in 45 kitchens, with 89,977 narrated verb-noun action segments.

annotations.coverageNote: All 700 videos are fully narrated; 89,977 action segments span the 100 h. VISOR, EPIC-Fields and EPIC-SOUNDS are add-on releases on the same videos.

narrations.note: Wearer pause-and-talk narrations, transcribed and timestamped

action_labels.note: 97 verb / 300 noun classes with start/stop timestamps and frame indices

object_boxes.note: 454K boxes inherited from EK-55 frames; VISOR adds 67K hand-object relations

segmentation.note: VISOR: 271K manual + 9.9M dense masks over 257 object classes

camera_pose.note: EPIC-Fields: camera poses for 671 videos / 18.7M registered frames

audio_transcript.note: Narration transcripts; EPIC-SOUNDS adds 78.4K audio-event segments (44 classes)

samples.caption: Nine kitchens side by side with their narrations, e.g. 'stir chicken', 'stretch dough'
Hand-object detections (L-P / R-P / O boxes) and segmentation masks on EK-100 frames
